description: This file contains Perl test scripts for CAPTCHA validation and registration form behavior, utilizing the Test2 framework and custom Test::Coocook methods.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A custom testing class providing methods for web request simulation and validation in the context of CAPTCHA and registration testing.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object with optional test data configuration.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP POST request to a specified URL with given parameters.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP response status matches the expected value.

methods.name: text_like
methods.description: Validates that the response text matches a given regex pattern.

methods.name: local_config_guard
methods.description: Temporarily overrides local configuration settings for CAPTCHA behavior within a scope.

methods.name: register_fails_like
methods.description: Attempts registration with given input and expects failure matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: content_contains
methods.description: Checks if the response content contains a specific string or pattern.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs a GET request and expects a successful response.

methods.name: submit_form_fails
methods.description: Submits a form with specified fields and expects failure.

methods.name: schema->resultset
methods.description: Accesses the database schema's result set for 'User' to verify user existence.
